status: approved v11 geometry; print-set-v2 candidate, pending slicer and physical verification

selection_method.selection_reason: The 16-pose set retains both v11 baked roll directions, the complete single-arc endpoint, wave onset, intermediate wave growth, strong-wave onset, and final form. Its maximum translation-only all-vertex RMS is below 0.31 mm; the 12-pose alternative reaches 0.93 mm and skips a more visible arc-growth step.
selection_method.rigid_transform_check: Vertex correspondence was tested under X-axis rotation plus Y/Z translation. Selected frame assignments already share the required baked roll orientation; best-fit additional rotations are below 0.016 degrees. Reproduction uses no additional rotation so the STL contact plane remains level; only millimeter-scale Y placement corrections are applied.
selection_method.geometry_policy: Each STL is exported from a deterministic independent v11 mesh regeneration and matched to the saved v11 mesh fingerprint. Reused frames use only rigid placement; mesh interpolation, scaling, mirroring, and deformation are not used.

validation.minimum_thickness: Exhaustive local minimum-thickness analysis was not performed.
validation.slicer_and_physical_print: Not performed; geometry checks do not guarantee successful FDM printing.
